description: This file contains unit tests for a thread pool implementation, including job scheduling, cancellation, rescheduling, and worker management, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: EventControl
classes.description: A helper class to manage event signaling for synchronization in tests.

classes.name: TestJob
classes.description: A templated class representing a test job that can be dispatched, canceled, and completed, used for testing thread pool behavior.

classes.name: JobControl
classes.description: Manages job submission, notification, and external worker threads for a given implementation.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Implements scheduling of jobs with timers within the thread pool.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Dispatches jobs by invoking their Dispatch method.

classes.name: ThreadPoolTester
classes.description: A test subclass of ThreadPool that manages jobs and workers for testing purposes.

classes.name: MinionTester
classes.description: A test subclass of Minion that manages job processing and worker threads for testing.

classes.name: ThreadJobTester
classes.description: A test job class that supports submit, reschedule, revoke, and idle operations, used for testing job lifecycle.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals the event to indicate a condition has occurred.

methods.name: WaitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled or timeout.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the event to non-signaled state.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the test job.

methods.name: Cancelled
methods.description: Marks the job as canceled.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Executes the job, marks as completed, and notifies.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the worker thread and waits for it to finish.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Main worker loop for external worker threads.

methods.name: SubmitUsingSelfWorker
methods.description: Submits a job to be processed by the same thread pool.

methods.name: SubmitUsingExternalWorker
methods.description: Submits a job to be processed by an external worker thread.

methods.name: WaitForReady
methods.description: Waits until a specific job is ready or times out.

methods.name: NotifyReady
methods.description: Notifies that a job is ready.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a job, marking it as canceled.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Marks a job as completed and updates its status.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the thread pool processing.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the thread pool and all associated workers.

methods.name: Runs
methods.description: Retrieves the number of times each thread has run.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending jobs.

methods.name: QueueIsFull
methods.description: Checks if the job queue is full.

methods.name: QueueIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the job queue is empty.
